owner_goal: Build at least one confirmed M5 or M15 symbol sleeve with PF above 1.30 after verified cost, cadence of 2 to 5 executed trades per elapsed calendar week on every relevant split, and strict robustness against overfitting. T1 through T100 are sequential generations and stop only after a valid target pass.
capability_target: Distinguish a QAWAP-aligned displacement caused by a persistent and temporally asymmetric state from short-memory noise, then trade or abstain with calibrated uncertainty.

mechanism_boundary.claim: Broker quote activity, causal price location and return-path irreversibility may jointly identify a short-lived continuation state after cost.
not_claimed: broker tick volume is centralized traded volume or signed order flow
a point Hurst estimate above 0.5 proves persistence
one profitable aggregate can rescue a losing symbol
prior_failure_radius_excluded: single-window classical R/S Hurst filter on USDJPY M15
Hurst substitution inside a killed regime-gated mean-reversion object
session-VWAP bounce, reclaim or standard-deviation-band rule
terminal VRAS seven-gap object and its one-bar path-confirmation child
post-outcome session, weekday, year, stop, target or direction rescue

universe_contract.tester_model_semantics: Every tick generated from M1 bars; not broker real ticks.
universe_contract.exact_coverage_proof: Per-symbol tester-journal history-synchronized start/end, report, run manifest and hashes must agree.
required_attribution: per-symbol train, calibration, validation, OOS and T1-locked holdout
universe_contract.no_skip_rule: No mandatory symbol may be omitted because Model 4, verified cost or long real-tick coverage is missing. Missing promotion evidence limits the claim; it does not remove the Model-0 cell.
symbol_specific_permissions: point, tick size, tick value and volume geometry

clock_and_cadence.entry: First available tick/open of the M5 bar after the completed decision bar
clock_and_cadence.same_day_selection: First qualifying upward probability crossing wins; later signals are ignored.
clock_and_cadence.btc_weekends: Observed but not eligible; BTC uses the same Monday-Friday decision contract.
clock_and_cadence.cadence_gate: 2 to 5 executed trades per elapsed calendar week on each claimed symbol and each relevant split; no active-week or pooled-symbol denominator.

feature_contract.price: Typical price equals (high + low + close) / 3 on completed M5 bars.
feature_contract.qawap: Cumulative typical-price times broker tick-volume divided by cumulative broker tick-volume since 00:00 UTC.

memory.input: Latest 256 valid completed-M5 log returns; exclude the first return after a gap over 15 minutes.
memory.uncertain_rule: UNCERTAIN when local-Whittle and DFA differ by more than 0.10 or Lo/surrogate controls do not support persistence.

directed_hvg.input: (close - QAWAP) / ATR14 on contiguous completed M5 bars

feature_contract.normalization: Train-only median and MAD by symbol; pooled model receives no symbol identifier.
feature_contract.pooling_weight: Each symbol has total weight 1/9 and each calendar year within a symbol has equal weight in the training objective.

label_exit_and_risk.cost_unit: c_s_t = max(observed spread_t, train P90 non-zero spread_s) + commission proxy_s + 2 * tick_size_s, from a hash-bound non-zero cost manifest.
close_only_path: For completed bars j=1..6 compute signed z_j = direction * (close_j - entry_price).
If z_j <= -1.00R, emit CLOSE_STOP and execute at the next M5 open.
Else if z_j >= +1.25R, emit CLOSE_TARGET and execute at the next M5 open.
Else after bar 6 emit TIME_EXIT and execute at the next M5 open.
label_exit_and_risk.label: Y=1 only for target-before-stop-before-timeout under the close-only sequence; adverse-first and timeout are Y=0.
label_exit_and_risk.trade_threshold: Calibrated probability must cross upward through p_BE + 0.05.
label_exit_and_risk.tail_treatment: Retain next-open gaps and realized losses without clipping.

model_and_arms.model: L2 logistic regression with lambda=1, common coefficients across symbols and no optimizer.
model_and_arms.calibration: One pooled sigmoid calibrator fitted only on calibration portions with equal symbol weighting.

arms.features: equal-weight/session-open displacement, six-bar return, ATR14, session age, cost and variance ratio
QAWAP distance and slope, relative tick activity, ATR14, session age and cost
A1 plus local-Whittle, DFA and Lo uncertainty state
A1 plus the three frozen directed-HVG features

model_and_arms.mt5_program: After train/calibration coefficients are frozen, every one of the 45 arm-symbol cells receives one serial all-available-history MT5 Model-0 run. Split and cost-stress attribution from the same frozen trade sequence do not create a new strategy trial.
model_and_arms.invalid_run_rule: A data or engineering invalid run consumes its attempt identity but no economic conclusion; only a bounded logic-identical repair is allowed.
model_and_arms.selection_rule: Any arm may survive absolute gates, but component value is claimed only through its matched ablation. Simpler survivors are preferred when added complexity fails incremental gates.

split_contract.basis: Per-symbol elapsed UTC coverage after warm-up, not bar count.
split_contract.holdout_label: T1-locked holdout, not globally virgin workspace history
split_contract.holdout_open: Open once after source, coefficients, calibrator, task packets, cost contract and all identities are frozen.

pre_outcome_gates: Exact broker symbol mapping and a proposed all-available-history boundary exist for all nine symbols.
The harness can capture and hash report History Quality plus tester-journal synchronized start/end.
Strict numeric History Quality >97 is fail-closed for T1 task packets.
QAWAP, ATR, memory and HVG Python-reference to MQL5 parity passes frozen tolerances.
Short-memory, ARMA, GARCH and regime-break synthetic false persistence is <=5%.
Power at simulated d=0.10 is >=80% and median local-Whittle bias is <=0.05.
No feature, label, entry or exit reads an incomplete bar or future graph edge.
Outcome-blind candidate days are at least 3 per elapsed week in each mandatory symbol and split.
The same unit-normalized logic can execute on all symbols without symbol-specific strategy parameters.
Cost fields are non-zero or explicitly marked unavailable; unavailable verified cost blocks promotion.

economic_success_contract.cadence: 2 to 5 executed trades per elapsed calendar week in train, validation, OOS, T1-locked holdout, all history and relevant 2018-current attribution
economic_success_contract.directional_stability: Positive net expectancy in long and short directions.
economic_success_contract.time_stability: Positive expectancy in a majority of half-years and no single half-year is allowed to create the whole positive result.
economic_success_contract.calibration: Block-bootstrap 95% lower bound of Brier skill over climatology >0; slope 0.8..1.2; absolute intercept <=0.10; ECE <=0.05.
economic_success_contract.robustness: WFA, PBO, Reality Check/DSR with multiplicity 45, parameter-neighborhood stability, cost/execution audit, non-repaint audit and independent QC all pass.
economic_success_contract.forensics: At least 100 seed-frozen random executed trade episodes with decision-asof and anatomy images bound to report/log IDs.
economic_success_contract.promotion_limit: Research proxy cost may kill but cannot confirm. Confirmed status requires verified same-broker spread, commission and slippage evidence.

A4_vs_A1: cadence remains 2 to 5 per elapsed week
incremental_component_gates.A2_vs_A1: Required before claiming memory adds value.
incremental_component_gates.A3_vs_A1: Required before claiming graph structure adds value.
incremental_component_gates.exposure_only_improvement: A drawdown improvement caused only by fewer trades is not incremental edge.

verdict_routes.TARGET_PASS: At least one arm-symbol sleeve passes every absolute, split, cost, robustness, overfit, forensic and independent-QC gate. All nine symbol results remain reported.
verdict_routes.VALID_FAIL_T1: All required data and engineering are valid but no symbol sleeve survives. Close only the exact T1 object, write failure radius and open T2.
verdict_routes.INVALID_REPAIR_T1: History quality, coverage, identity, implementation, parity, log or cost mechanics invalidate inference. Repair the frozen object without changing market logic.
verdict_routes.INSUFFICIENT_T1: Frozen all-history evidence cannot decide due coverage or observation limits. Do not call it no-edge and do not post-hoc extend the object.
